advice_boundary: AiFA computes and organises e-Invoice-relevant figures and submission state from these rules; it does not replace a licensed tax professional's formal advice or filing responsibility (Vol 6_9 Section 5).
source_note: A first-draft rule set only — this sprint has no live LHDN MyInvois sandbox connection (see Sprint 33's own Outcomes), so these validation rules have not been checked against a real IRB response. Correcting a rule here is a data update to this file, not a code change, once real sandbox feedback is available.

consolidation_rule.description: A consolidated e-Invoice batch may only include non-B2B (consumer) transactions for the stated period; a buyer with a registered TIN must receive its own itemised e-Invoice, not be folded into a consolidated batch.
consolidation_rule.server_side_mapping: public.generate_consolidated_einvoice_batch treats a Party with no tin set as eligible for consolidation, and a Party with a tin set as B2B (excluded) — an approximation of the real LHDN eligibility test, disclosed in the Sprint 33 migration's own header note 4.
